description: Stages files for commit. Returns structured data with count and list of staged files, including how many were newly staged. Pass `path` to target a specific repo or worktree — when omitted, operates on the server's own working directory, not the caller's (see #876).

files.description: File paths to stage (required unless all is true)

ignoreErrors.description: Continue staging past individual file failures (--ignore-errors)

ignoreRemoval.description: Add new and modified files but do not stage deletions (--ignore-removal)

path.description: Repository path. Authoritative — when omitted, the server uses its own process working directory (its launch dir, not the caller's cwd). Callers in a git worktree or other directory MUST pass this explicitly to avoid operating on the wrong repo.

renormalize.description: Re-apply clean filters to all tracked files (--renormalize)

update.description: Stage only modifications to tracked files, excluding untracked files (-u)

name: add
title: Git Add
